title: Top Board Games for Family Game Night (2026)
summary: Ticket to Ride, Labyrinth, Catan, and Everdell stand out as the most frequently praised family board games of 2026, offering a mix of strategy, accessibility, and replayability.
method: Selected titles that appear in more than one trusted review site (Mumsnet, Independent, Runwild) and highlighted their best‑overall or best‑family designations.
assumptions: Prices are only included when a source lists them; otherwise the price field is null.

products.name: Ticket to Ride
why: Best family board game overall according to Mumsnet
Best family board game overall according to Independent
products.best_for: Families who enjoy route‑building and competitive strategy
products.skip_if: You prefer a quick, low‑setup game

products.name: Labyrinth
why: Best classic family board game according to Mumsnet
Best classic family board game according to Independent
products.best_for: Families looking for a timeless maze‑puzzle adventure
products.skip_if: You need a game that supports more than 4 players

products.name: Catan
why: Best strategy family board game according to Independent
products.best_for: Families who enjoy resource management and trading
products.skip_if: You want a game that is easy for very young children
